nodes.name: URL Shortener
nodes.what: Creates short links and redirects clicks to long URLs
nodes.why: Provide Bitly-like short links with owner click counts

nodes.name: Key Range Service
nodes.why: Lets creators assign codes without colliding

nodes.name: Link Service
nodes.what: Creates short links from assigned ranges
nodes.why: Handles link creation separately from redirect load

nodes.name: Link Store
nodes.what: Key-value table of code to long URL
nodes.why: Durable source of truth for links

nodes.name: Redirect Service
nodes.what: Resolves short codes to long URLs
nodes.why: Serves high-volume redirects within latency budget

flags.intent: Redirect Service serves high-volume redirects within latency budget and never blocks on counting with fire-and-forget click event publish
flags.difference: Delivered handler awaits `UPDATE links SET clicks = clicks + 1` before 301, blocking the redirect path on counting instead of fire-and-forget publish; collapses cache-resolver and click-emitter responsibilities directly into the handler.

nodes.name: Redirect Cache
nodes.what: Caches hot code to URL mappings

nodes.name: Click Aggregator
nodes.why: Keep redirect fast while enabling counts

nodes.name: Redirect Handler
nodes.why: Keeps edge path fast and isolated from lookups

nodes.name: Cache Resolver
nodes.what: Read-through resolve from cache then store
